entities.summary: Bernardo De Dominici or Bernardo de Dominici or Bernardo de' Dominici was an Italian art historian and minor landscape and genre painter, active mainly in his native Naples. He is now best known as the author of the Vite dei pittori, scultori ed architetti napoletani, a three-volume collection of biographies of Neapolitan artists, for which he is sometimes called the Vasari of Naples.
